title: LEARNING TO LIE: REINFORCEMENT LEARNING ATTACKS DAMAGE HUMAN-AI TEAMS AND TEAMS OF LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the evolution of human trust and influence point allocation toward an AI assistant during an intellective strategy game, specifically analyzing human teams' over-reliance on AI and their susceptibility to an adversarial AI that strategically provides incorrect answers.

Analyzing the effect of limited working memory by training predictive machine learning models and evaluating LLMs with varying window sizes of past performance data, observing that recent rounds predominantly drive influence allocation decisions.
